country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Kao Data Greater Manchester / Kenwood Point data centre
notes: Planning permission granted 27 March 2024 for a 40MW facility at Kenwood Point, Stockport; Stockport Council later reported construction had commenced at the Reddish site, with operation expected in 2026.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AWS Burderop Hospital / Brimble Hill data centre
notes: Swindon Borough Council approved a four-hall data centre on the former HP Burderop Hospital site; DCD reported planning documents identified Amazon Data Services/AWS and 27MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: nLighten Swindon data centre upgrade
notes: Swindon Borough Council reported nLighten planned to invest up to GBP10m in its South Marston Industrial Estate data centre for upgrades, security, modernisation and future expansion; nLighten lists the Swindon edge location with 19,300 kW of power.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Proximity Edge 7 Swindon data centre
notes: Proximity acquired the former Capgemini Merlin facility in 2021; Colo-X describes the operational South Marston site as 7MW / 2,000 racks with Tier III-standard design.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Nationwide Swindon Technology Centre server-farm expansion
notes: Nationwide applied to Swindon Borough Council in November 2023 to expand the existing server farm at Hillmead Drive by converting delivery bays to plant areas and adding roof plant space.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ashton Old Baths commercial data centre
notes: Phase two of Ashton Old Baths completed in 2021 and included Tameside's first commercial data centre, hosting council, NHS and public-sector partner systems with business hosting available.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Google Thurrock Data Centre / former Arena Essex campus
notes: Project website says Google is bringing forward a planned data-centre campus south of the M25/A13 junction under Thurrock planning application 25/00573/OUT; environmental statement identifies GIUK as applicant for the former Arena Essex site.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Gateway Data Centre, West Thurrock
developer: GVA Connect / Gateway Data Centre site promoters
notes: DCD reported the Gateway Data Centre site in West Thurrock had all necessary planning permissions, 86,000 sq ft of white space, 210,000 sq ft GIA and up to 50MVA of power potentially available; MW was not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Leigh Infirmary NHS data centre consolidation and TIA-942 certification
developer: Wrightington, Wigan and Leigh NHS Foundation Trust / Capitoline
notes: Capitoline says a 2011 consolidation project formed a new data centre at Leigh Infirmary to provide secure IT services for the Trust and selected public-sector customers, later achieving TIA-942 certification.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council
name: BE Bournemouth data centre
notes: The BE Company facility at County Gates House, Poole is described in the April 2025 spec sheet as operational since 2009, with 0.6MW total capacity, up to 400kW IT load and 3MW scaling potential.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AWS / former HP Amen Corner Bracknell data centre
notes: Plans were filed in 2021 for a four-data-hall facility on the former HP site at Cain Road/Amen Corner; Baxtel reports AWS operates the completed Bracknell facility with approximately 27MW total IT load and Bracknell Forest application 21/00239/FUL.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Keppel DC REIT London Data Centre / Waterside House
notes: Keppel DC REIT agreed to acquire Waterside House in Bracknell for GBP57m and rename it London Data Centre; the Bracknell town-centre property is fully leased to Vodafone through 2039 and was refurbished in 2015.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green Bradford heat-reuse data centre
notes: 1Energy and DCD report planning approval for Deep Green's 5.6MW heat-reusing facility on Listerhills Road, adjacent to the Thornton Road Energy Centre, to supply waste heat to the Bradford Energy Network.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Brighton Digital Exchange (BDX) data centre
developer: Brighton Digital Exchange Co-operative / Wired Sussex / Sudlows
notes: The GBP700,000 BDX project converted part of New England House into a 270 sq m cooperative data-centre/digital-exchange facility for Brighton's digital businesses; Sudlows lists critical power, UPS, generator, CRAC, fire suppression and security components.
